alternatives.argument: The assigned algorithm states the exact cell fluxes, mortality loss, absorbing boundary and CFL. Perthame supplies finite-age upwind context; the local update is explicit and well-defined.
The local matrix proof expands every coefficient, uses positive birth weights and telescopes the mass balance; it establishes the renewal-boundary result independently.
The local Taylor calculation gives face, reaction and true birth-quadrature defects, then the discrete recurrence proves the error bound; no general upwind order claim is imported.
The local proof derives the renewal-boundary variation recurrence, tightness, discrete weak identity and characteristic uniqueness; the renewal BV claim is established locally.

The assigned size algorithm explicitly defines variable-width fluxes and positive kernel coefficients. Perthame supports the size-population model; Rutgers/Kent midpoint texts support positive quadrature weights.

The local proof compares initial cohort measures through the bounded-Lipschitz defect, controls Euler survival error using the actual forward-Euler supplier, bounds the discrete birth recurrence and adds the omitted-tail term through the actual semigroup stability theorem. The full argument is independent of the upwind lecture source.
The complete example computes the midpoint birth rate, CFL and mass vector from the assigned algorithm and positivity theorem; every finite value is shown locally.
